Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000459": On 2025-06-09 Oskar wrote the billing API handover doc for Lena.  (about: Lena, Oskar, billing API handover doc)
- memory_id "1000453" [decision]: On 2025-06-06 the Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000442" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000404": On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000384": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000368": As of 2025-04-29, the job scheduler still relies on the feature-flags service.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000321": As of 2025-04-07, the Ember team reported that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000286": On 2025-03-26 the Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000284" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000253": The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000130": The reporting service is owned by the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000109" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000101": Farah has the first on-call rotation for the Dune team.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000089": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
